sourceDef: ISO 639-1 language code.
targetDef: The specified language to which the digital asset is targeted. It is recommended to use the ISO 639-1 language code.

sourceDef: ISO 639-1 language code. See also gs1:fileLanguageCode.
targetDef: The specified language to which the digital asset is targeted. It is recommended to use the ISO 639-1 language code.

sourceDef: Unique identifier of the manufacturing facility (recommended: GS1 GLN). Sits on the oec:FacilityInformation referenced by eubat:manufacturingPlace.
targetDef: A Global Location Number (GLN) is the GS1 Identification Key used to identify physical locations or parties. The key comprises a GS1 Company Prefix, Location Reference and Check Digit. For more information see https://www.gs1.org/gln.

sourceDef: URL to the measurement certificate document.
targetDef: A link to certification information.

sourceDef: URL to general safety instructions document.
targetDef: A link to safety information.

sourceDef: URL to the verification certificate document.
targetDef: If gs1:certificationURI is present, it should point to data about this individual certificate within a repository maintained by the certification agency.

sourceDef: Date when third-party verification was completed.
targetDef: Date of completion of the auditing needed for certification

sourceDef: The physical form of the detergent product (liquid, powder, capsule, etc.).
targetDef: The physical form or shape of the product. Used, for example, in pharmaceutical industry to indicate the formulation of the product. Defines the form the product takes and is distinct from the form of the packaging.

sourceDef: Start date of the exemption's validity. Before this date the exemption does not apply.
targetDef: The earliest date from which the referenced information becomes applicable.

sourceDef: Container for geolocation and producer identification.
targetDef: A description of the geographic area the item may have originated from or has been processed.

sourceDef: List of origin details (one per geolocation or polygon).
targetDef: A description of the geographic area the item may have originated from or has been processed.

sourceDef: Hazardous waste arising from the treatment of a WEEE item, with the consignment\ndescription and the reference of the treatment certificate issued for it.
targetDef: Certification issued by a certifying body to a certification subject (Organization, Place, Product).

sourceDef: The treatment or recycling process applied to the item.
targetDef: The process the packaging could undertake for recyclable & sustainability programs. Examples COMPOSTABLE, ENERGY_RECOVERABLE, REUSABLE.

sourceDef: Reference of the certificate issued for the treatment or disposal of the hazardous waste consignment.
targetDef: A reference (i.e, to a certificate instance) issued to confirm that a product, party or location has passed certification. e.g. 'XSC-C-12345'

sourceDef: The treatment route applied to the removed battery (for example hydrometallurgical or pyrometallurgical recycling).
targetDef: The process the packaging could undertake for recyclable & sustainability programs. Examples COMPOSTABLE, ENERGY_RECOVERABLE, REUSABLE.

sourceDef: Heat (melt) number identifying the batch of molten steel from which the product was cast (EN 10168 traceability).
targetDef: The batch or lot number associates an item with information the manufacturer considers relevant for traceability of the trade item to which the element string is applied. The data may refer to the trade item itself or to items contained. The number may be, for example, a production lot number, a shift number, a machine number, a time, or an internal production code. In cases where the same product is manufactured in different locations the brand owner and the manufacturer are responsible for ensuring the non-duplication of batch/lot numbers for a GTIN. For the re-use of batch/lot numbers with a GTIN, sector-specific constraints need to be considered.

sourceDef: Nominal dimension of the tested product (mm).
targetDef: The numerical size measurement relating to the size type.

sourceDef: Reference to an external document such as reports, certificates,\nmanuals, or guides. Supports multiple languages and formats.\nSee also gs1:ReferencedFileDetails for GS1 Web Vocabulary equivalent.
targetDef: Provides URL and other information on a referenced electronic file.

sourceDef: Types of supporting documents for DPP.\nSee also gs1:ReferencedFileTypeCode for GS1 standard document types (PRODUCT_MANUAL, SAFETY_DATA_SHEET, CERTIFICATE, etc.).

Economic operator information as required by various EU regulations.
Captures manufacturer, importer, distributor, and other operator roles.
Use gs1:globalLocationNumber for operator identification (inherited from gs1:Organization).
Use GS1 Digital Link format: https://id.gs1.org/417/{GLN}
targetDef: Government bodies, trade organisations, and other parties issue identifiers that are associated to legal entities and/or functions. Linking these identifiers to GLN and one another supports consolidating records, mapping related, collaborative identifiers, enhances search ability and enables more efficient transitions between identifiers.  This class provides a mechanism for connecting and sharing party identifiers.

sourceDef: Refundable deposit applied at point of sale. Modelled as gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode = ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. 'EUR'). Prefer the upstream gs1:returnablePackageDepositAmount (range gs1:PriceSpecification) where the GS1 packaging model is in use; this property remains for QuantitativeValue-based expressions.
targetDef: The monetary amount for the individual returnable package.

sourceDef: Links a product (typically gs1:PackagingDetails) to the DRS it participates in. Where the GS1 packaging model is in use, prefer the upstream gs1:hasReturnablePackageDeposit (gs1:PackagingDetails \u2192 gs1:ReturnablePackageDepositDetails); since oec:DepositReturnScheme subclasses the GS1 target class, the same node works for both.
targetDef: links to details of amounts refunded for returnable package in a specified region.

sourceDef: URL to the document. See also gs1:referencedFileURL.
targetDef: Link to a file or website containing additional information on product.

sourceDef: Supporting documents for the product. DPP-specific counterpart to gs1:referencedFile: the oec:DocumentReference range adds document typing and ESPR access-rights semantics that gs1:ReferencedFileDetails does not carry.
targetDef: Link to a file or website containing additional information on product.

sourceDef: Declared unit for this indicator (e.g. kg CO2 eq, kg CFC11 eq, mol H+ eq, m3 world eq deprived).
targetDef: A string value indicating a Measurement Unit from UN/ECE Recommendation 20, Units of Measure used in International Trade e.g. GRM = gram - see http://www.unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/cefact/recommendations/rec20/rec20_rev3_Annex3e.pdf

sourceDef: Language tag of a value (EN 18223 4.1.2.8.2): ISO 639 language plus EN ISO 3166-1 country, for example \"en-GB\".
targetDef: The specified language to which the digital asset is targeted. It is recommended to use the ISO 639-1 language code.

sourceDef: Role of the economic operator (manufacturer, importer, etc.).
targetDef: The role and/or purpose of a party (i.e. legal entity or function).  Multiple values from gs1:OrganizationRoleType code list may be associated to a single organisation/party.

sourceDef: Identifier of a permit, authorisation, or type-examination certificate issued by a regulatory body for the trade item. Used inside a gs1:regulatoryInformation block.
targetDef: A reference number for a record, document or dataset stored within a regulatory information system, repository or registry.

sourceDef: Repair and maintenance information for the product.
targetDef: A link to service or maintenance instructions.
Links to after-hours contact information. For general contact details, gs1:contactPoint SHALL be used.

sourceDef: List of countries of origin where geolocations are located.
targetDef: Code indicating the country of origin of the product.

sourceDef: Reference to FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) certification.
targetDef: Indicates the type of certification

sourceDef: Container for geolocation and producer identification.
targetDef: Code indicating the country of origin of the product.

sourceDef: Container for geolocation and producer identification.
targetDef: Free text description of the region or place the product originates from. This is to be specifically used to specify areas such as cities, mountain ranges, regions. Examples: Made in the Thuringen Mountains, Made in Paris, From the Napa Valley.

sourceDef:
A textile product in scope of the EU Textile Labelling Regulation 1007/2011 and
the ESPR textile delegated act. Base class of the module: it is the domain of the
textile-specific properties and the target of eutex:TextileProductShape. Broader than
gs1:WearableProduct, since it also covers HomeTextiles and TechnicalTextiles; the
wearable slice is carried by the dual-inheritance subclasses eutex:TextileApparel and
eutex:TextileFootwear.
targetDef: Products that are worn on the body.

sourceDef: Season and year of the collection (e.g., FW2024, SS2025).
targetDef: The calendar year in which the product is seasonally available.

sourceDef: Season and year of the collection (e.g., FW2024, SS2025).
targetDef: Element defines the season applicable to the item for example Winter.

sourceDef: Third-party certification verifying the recycled content claim. Use gs1:CertificationDetails pattern.
targetDef: Indicates the type of certification

sourceDef: Material composition information including source country,\npercentage, and critical raw material classification.
targetDef: Information on any material used for packaging.

sourceDef: Material composition information including source country,\npercentage, and critical raw material classification.
targetDef: Details on the composition of any materials used to make a product using textiles.

sourceDef: Human-readable name of the material or component (e.g. a fibre type, alloy, or constituent material).
targetDef: The name of any additive or genetic modification contained or not contained in the product .
The materials used for the packaging of the product for example glass or plastic.
This provides a name or brief description of one material contained within the product, for example Rayon.
One or more links to information about the materials used in a wearable product.

sourceDef: Economic operator responsible for the product.
targetDef: The organization that produces the item.

sourceDef: Net mass of the battery. Use unitCode 'KGM' (kilogram) per UN/CEFACT Rec 20. Sub-property of gs1:netWeight to keep GS1-first.
targetDef: Used to identify the net weight of the product. Net Weight excludes all packaging material, including the packaging material of all lower-level GTINs. Example:11.5 kgm.

sourceDef: Certification or accreditation of the data provider.
targetDef: A reference (i.e, to a certificate instance) issued to confirm that a product, party or location has passed certification. e.g. 'XSC-C-12345'

sourceDef: Certification or accreditation of the data provider.
targetDef: Certification information about a product, organisation or location.

sourceDef: Reference to the dismantling and removal instructions document required by EU Battery Regulation Annex VIII \u00A7B.

sourceDef: Reference to dismantling instructions document for safe disassembly of the battery.

targetDef: Simple text string that refers to a resource on the internet, URLs may refer to documents, resources, people, etc.

targetDef: A link to safety information.

targetDef: A link to safety information.

sourceDef:
A construction product subject to EU Regulation 2024/3110 (revised
CPR). Carrier for the regulation's DPP and Declaration-of-Performance data.
Use eucpr:declarationOfPerformanceUrl, eucpr:essentialCharacteristic, and
eucpr:reactionToFireClass for the substantive declarations; reuse oec: terms
for recycled content, carbon footprint, hazardous substances, etc.
targetDef: Any item (product or service) upon which there is a need to retrieve pre-defined information and that may be priced, or ordered, or invoiced at any point in any supply chain.

sourceDef: A detergent or surfactant product subject to EU 2026/405. Use as @type alongside gs1:Product. The DPP is model-based: same manufacturer + identical formulation = one DPP.
targetDef: Any item (product or service) upon which there is a need to retrieve pre-defined information and that may be priced, or ordered, or invoiced at any point in any supply chain.

sourceDef: A fragrance allergen that must be disclosed when present above the concentration threshold, identified by name and CAS number.
targetDef: Details of an allergen for a product.

sourceDef: Human-readable dosage instructions including water hardness guidance.
targetDef: Free text containing the usage instructions of a product, which are normally held on the label or accompanying the product. This information may or may not be labelled on the pack.

sourceDef: List of ingredients in the detergent formulation, using INCI nomenclature.
targetDef: Free text field describing an ingredient or ingredient group. Ingredients include any additives (colourings, preservatives, e-numbers, etc.) that are encompassed.

sourceDef: List of ingredients in the detergent formulation, using INCI nomenclature.
targetDef: Information on the constituent ingredient make up of the product specified as one string.

sourceDef: Description of the product's intended use or application.
targetDef: Free text containing the usage instructions of a product, which are normally held on the label or accompanying the product. This information may or may not be labelled on the pack.

sourceDef: Total elemental phosphorus content as weight percentage.
targetDef: Quantity of the ingredient contained in the product as a percentage of the total product ingredients. This is used in conjunction with ingredientName.

targetDef: A link to safety information.

sourceDef: List of countries of origin where geolocations are located.
targetDef: A description of the geographic area the item may have originated from or has been processed.

sourceDef: The specific batch, lot, or serial identifier (or list thereof) that is in scope of a temporary exemption. For 'batch' scope this is the lot/batch number; for 'serial' scope it is the serial number.
targetDef: The batch or lot number associates an item with information the manufacturer considers relevant for traceability of the trade item to which the element string is applied. The data may refer to the trade item itself or to items contained. The number may be, for example, a production lot number, a shift number, a machine number, a time, or an internal production code. In cases where the same product is manufactured in different locations the brand owner and the manufacturer are responsible for ensuring the non-duplication of batch/lot numbers for a GTIN. For the re-use of batch/lot numbers with a GTIN, sector-specific constraints need to be considered.

sourceDef: URL to list of authorized service centers.
targetDef: A link to service or maintenance instructions.

sourceDef: Whether this material is a Substance of Very High Concern (SVHC) per REACH.
targetDef: Indicates a claim to an ingredient, considered to be a concern for regulatory or other reasons, and which is 'contained' within the product but may not need to specify the amount whether approximate, or an accurate measurement be given.

The upper limit drinking temperature of the optimum range of the drinking temperature. The optimum range of the drinking temperature is a recommendation and is based on the experience of the individual producer. Allows for the representation of the same value in different units of measure but not multiple values.

sourceDef: Top-level construction product family per CPR Annex III.
targetDef: Any item (product or service) upon which there is a need to retrieve pre-defined information and that may be priced, or ordered, or invoiced at any point in any supply chain.

sourceDef: Quantitative value of the essential characteristic. gs1:QuantitativeValue with the unitCode appropriate for the characteristic (e.g. 'N31' for MPa, 'F94' for W/(m\u00B7K)).
targetDef: A floating-point numeric value that is qualified by the corresponding measurement unit code - see gs1:unitCode

sourceDef: Physical form of the detergent product.
targetDef: Any item (product or service) upon which there is a need to retrieve pre-defined information and that may be priced, or ordered, or invoiced at any point in any supply chain.

sourceDef: CAS registry number of the fragrance allergen.
targetDef: Relates to details about allergens

sourceDef: Types of timber/wood products regulated by EUDR Annex I.
targetDef: Any item (product or service) upon which there is a need to retrieve pre-defined information and that may be priced, or ordered, or invoiced at any point in any supply chain.

sourceDef: Display refresh rate. Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode 'HTZ'.
targetDef: A floating-point numeric value that is qualified by the corresponding measurement unit code - see gs1:unitCode

sourceDef: Visible screen diagonal. Use gs1:QuantitativeValue with unitCode 'CMT' or 'INH'.
targetDef: A floating-point numeric value that is qualified by the corresponding measurement unit code - see gs1:unitCode

sourceDef: Price of the component as a spare part.
targetDef: The price related to an offer. If the offer is a multi-buy offer for a quantity of product greater than one unit, this should be indicated using the property gs1:eligibleQuantity

sourceDef:
A packaging item subject to EU Regulation 2025/40 (PPWR). Carrier
for the regulation's labelling and DPP data points. Reached from a trade
item via gs1:packaging (gs1:Product → gs1:PackagingDetails); when packaging
is itself placed on the market as a trade item (e.g. an empty e-commerce
carton), type the node as both gs1:Product and euppwr:Packaging. Use
packagingTier for the sales/grouped/transport position; use
recyclabilityGrade, gs1:packagingMaterial, gs1:packagingRecyclingProcessType,
gs1:hasReturnablePackageDeposit, oec:recycledContent, oec:Compostability,
oec:bioBasedFraction, etc. for the substantive declarations. Identified via
gs1:gtin; reusable/returnable packaging assets use GRAI (AI 8003).
targetDef: Information on any material used for packaging.

sourceDef:
A packaging item subject to EU Regulation 2025/40 (PPWR). Carrier
for the regulation's labelling and DPP data points. Reached from a trade
item via gs1:packaging (gs1:Product → gs1:PackagingDetails); when packaging
is itself placed on the market as a trade item (e.g. an empty e-commerce
carton), type the node as both gs1:Product and euppwr:Packaging. Use
packagingTier for the sales/grouped/transport position; use
recyclabilityGrade, gs1:packagingMaterial, gs1:packagingRecyclingProcessType,
gs1:hasReturnablePackageDeposit, oec:recycledContent, oec:Compostability,
oec:bioBasedFraction, etc. for the substantive declarations. Identified via
gs1:gtin; reusable/returnable packaging assets use GRAI (AI 8003).
targetDef: Details of the deposit for returnable packaging for a product.

sourceDef: Elastane/spandex content as percentage of total weight. Content >15% (>20% for PA6-rich >80% blends) makes product non-recyclable (score 0).
targetDef: Quantity of the ingredient contained in the product as a percentage of the total product ingredients. This is used in conjunction with ingredientName.

sourceDef: Whether the product carries the EU Ecolabel (Regulation (EC) 66/2010).
targetDef: The legally required/compulsory additional label information as stated on the product packaging or label.

sourceDef: The impact category value in the category-specific unit.
targetDef: A floating-point numeric value that is qualified by the corresponding measurement unit code - see gs1:unitCode

sourceDef: Total percentage of synthetic fibers that may shed microplastics.
targetDef: Quantity of the ingredient contained in the product as a percentage of the total product ingredients. This is used in conjunction with ingredientName.

sourceDef: A deposit-return scheme that the product participates in (PPWR Article 50, beverage container DRS in DE/AT/NL/SE/etc., and any future EU-harmonised DRS). Subclass of gs1:ReturnablePackageDepositDetails: instances carry the deposit amount and region via gs1:returnablePackageDepositAmount / gs1:returnablePackageDepositRegion and add the operator and redemption-channel data points GS1 does not model.
targetDef: Details of the deposit for returnable packaging for a product.

sourceDef: ESPR priority product categories per Annex I and delegated acts.
targetDef: A food, beverage or tobacco product.

sourceDef: ESPR priority product categories per Annex I and delegated acts.
targetDef: Any item (product or service) upon which there is a need to retrieve pre-defined information and that may be priced, or ordered, or invoiced at any point in any supply chain.

sourceDef: Aggregate value of the indicator across the declared lifecycle modules, in the declared unit.
targetDef: A floating-point numeric value that is qualified by the corresponding measurement unit code - see gs1:unitCode

sourceDef: Indicator value for this lifecycle module, in the indicator's declared unit.
targetDef: A floating-point numeric value that is qualified by the corresponding measurement unit code - see gs1:unitCode
The warranty associated with the product, as provided by the manufacturer.

sourceDef: FDA-defined categories of foods subject to FSMA 204 per the Food Traceability List (21 CFR 1.1300). The FDA list enumerates distinct food types with explicit splits (leafy greens non-cut vs fresh-cut; three cheese pasteurisation classes; individual produce items; four finfish classes). The FDA updates the list periodically; this enum reflects the 2022 publication.
targetDef: Contains properties related specifically to fruit and vegetable products.
